description: This is a PHP unit test class for the Reviewer entity in the OrangeHRM Performance module. It tests the creation, persistence, and retrieval of a Reviewer object, including associated entities such as Employee, ReviewerGroup, and PerformanceReview.

classes.name: ReviewerTest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for testing Reviewer entity creation and persistence in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating relevant database tables.

methods.name: testReviewerEntity
methods.description: Creates and persists an Employee, ReviewerGroup, PerformanceReview, and Reviewer; then verifies their attributes and relationships.
